# Mirefield Council: second conversation

**Date:** Thursday 8 October 2026

###### 00:00 - 00:20
**Eleanor Vance**

I might have a look at the benefits caseload data if there is time, but I would not count on it.

###### 00:20 - 00:44
**Dom Selvon**

Understood. What would help most is the committee timetable.

###### 00:44 - 01:07
**Eleanor Vance**

That I can do. I will email you the committee timetable on Monday.

###### 01:07 - 01:20
**Dom Selvon**

Thank you, that is enough to plan around.

expected.description: Eleanor Vance to email the committee timetable
expected.evidenceQuote: I will email you the committee timetable on Monday.

notes: A hedged intention sits next to a firm commitment. Only the firm one counts.
